svg.title: Distance Formula — project card
svg.desc: A whole maths lesson as one game, led by Swifty the voiced bird: plot the points, find the gaps, close the right triangle and let Pythagoras finish it. Built with Javascript, Svg, Web Audio. Live demo. Banner: the game's real title screen.
